assertion_receipt_validation.semantics: The validator resolves expected methods from the instrumentation inventory and parses the instrumentation output. Its exact-result comparison rejects missing, unexpected, duplicate, or failed outcomes. A successful profile job therefore establishes that the selected expected cases were recorded exactly once and passed the validator.

Downloading the API34-large ZIP with gh run download returned EOF in this environment, so its per-profile JSON payload was not independently extracted or reviewed locally. Findings rely on the successful in-workflow exact-result gates, checked-in selector list, and validator implementation; no claim of local artifact extraction is made.
